raw_text: Mumbai Port Trust detected unauthorized access to its vessel traffic management system and cargo scheduling database after attackers exploited a zero-day vulnerability in the port's legacy SCADA interface. Maritime traffic was temporarily rerouted to JNPT while incident response teams isolated affected systems. The National Critical Information Infrastructure Protection Centre issued a critical alert to all major Indian ports. Port operations are expected to resume fully within 48 hours.
